## Background

Max told us on day 1 we were going to do this, and now we are. We are looking at the concentrations of 5 chemicals in 4 different streams in puerto rico, looking at how the concentrations changed after a hurricane event.

## Data

Data came from a website online, but is housed within this directory in the data folder as .csv files.

## Methods

Concentrations were averaged over a moving 9 week interval


## Results

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
values <- read_csv("../output/cleandata.csv")

values |>
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(x = window_start, y = conc, color = site)
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(vars(Chem), scales = "free", ncol = 1)
```
